description.title: רופאים מומחים
description.summary: This table defines different types of doctors (e.g., רופא משפחה, רופא ילדים) qualified to provide in-home medical service as part of a Harel insurance plan. It details the requirements for a doctor to be considered a 'רופא מומחה'.
